description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'BudgetsScreen' which displays a list of budget items with the ability to edit each budget's limit via a dialog. It interacts with a provider 'BudgetsProvider' to fetch and update data, and uses custom 'BudgetCard' widgets for display.

classes.name: BudgetsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays a list of budgets with options to edit each budget limit.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the BudgetsScreen, displaying a list of BudgetCards and enabling editing of budget limits.
